learning_outcomes.text: Understand the importance of the computational fluid dynamics (CFD) method in engineering problem solving and new product design.
Knows the basic principles of HAD.
Knows the location of commercial HAD programs.
Defines the limitations of HAD applications.

syllabus_topics: INTRODUCTION: Importance of computational fluid dynamics (CFD), General view on problem definition and problem solving in fluid dynamics and heat transfer
COMMERCIAL CFD CODES: How do CFD codes work, Finite volume method, Grid geometry.
EXAMPLE 1: 1-dimensional heat conduction, Solution file and solution procedure.
DISCRETIZATION PROCEDURE WITH THE FINITE VOLUME METHOD: 1-dimensional heat conduction, Boundary conditions and source term expressions.
Boundary source linearization, General rules for the discretization of equations.
NUMERICAL EXACT SOLUTION OF THE 1-DIMENSIONAL HEAT CONDUCTION PROBLEM: Formulation of governing equations, Formulation of the algebraic equations
NUMERICAL EXACT SOLUTION OF THE 1-DIMENSIONAL HEAT CONDUCTION PROBLEM: Formulation of governing equations, Formulation of the algebraic equations
Interior cells, boundary cells, Numeric solution using algebraic equations.
EXAMPLE 2: Laminar flow in a sudden expansion channel, Solution file and solution procedure.
OTHER CFD METHOD SUBJECTS: Variable cell distributions, Blocking inside the computational domain.
Relaxation, Convergence and restart, Control of accuracy and validity of CFD solutions.
EXAMPLE 3: Transient natural convection, Solution file and solution procedure.
bibliography: Patankar, S. V., "Numerical Heat Transfer and Fluid Flow", McGraw-Hill, 1980.
Versteeg, H. K. and Malalasekera, W., ?An Introduction to Computational Fluid Dynamics?, Longman, 2007.
